resolution.note: JSONL readers drop the unterminated tail; test-hygiene rejects trim().split before JSON.parse

title: Polled JSONL readers in tests ignore a partially appended line
body:
Outcome: no worker or eval test parses a JSONL log line the fixture is still appending.
Evidence: t-q625vvc (#335) hit SyntaxError Unterminated string in state-trust rows() once its subtests ran concurrently; rows() used trim().split, which keeps a partial last line. Same trim().split shape in test/worker/input-bounds, hardening, recovery and test/evals/session.
Acceptance: those readers keep only newline-terminated rows (split, slice(0,-1)), or a test-hygiene check rejects trim().split on polled JSONL logs.
